FAQ

Real Questions Clients Ask Us.

How long does POP ceiling and screeding take for a 3-bedroom flat? −
For a standard 3-bedroom in Lagos, POP installation takes 4-6 days and screeding + paint takes another 3-4 days. We work with proper scaffolds and protect your floors. The finish in our photos — like the geometric POP with LED — is what you get, smooth and crack-free.
Do you work outside Victoria Island and Lekki? +
Yes. Our office is at Crown Court, 2 Oniru Rd, VI, but we deliver across Lagos — Ajah, Ibeju-Lekki, Yaba, Ikeja, and mainland. For large landscape or hardscape jobs outside Lagos, we charge a site visit fee that is deducted from the project cost.
Can you handle both interior and compound — stamped concrete, turf, drainage? +
Absolutely. That's our edge. We do stamped concrete driveways like the orange one in our gallery, artificial turf, walkway paving, retaining walls, garden design and drainage solutions. One team, one timeline, one clean handover.
Do you provide materials and hardware supply, or only labour? +
We provide full materials — lumber, paint mixing, cabinet hardware, glass cutting, tools on rental, fence material. You can also buy hardware directly from us at our store. This ensures quality control and saves you stress of sourcing fake materials.
How much does a full interior + POP package cost? +
Costs depend on size, design complexity and materials. A basic POP + screeding for a room starts from ₦180k, kitchen cabinetry from ₦900k, stamped concrete from ₦12k per sqm. Send us your floor plan or site photos via the form and we will give you a detailed BOQ within 24-48hrs — free.
